'''Diihara Val''' was a representative for the [[Mek-Sha Tradehouse]], an auction establishment located on [[Mek-Sha]].

==Biography==
During the [[Third Galactic War|new conflict]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the [[Alliance Commander]] traveled to [[Huttbreaker's compound]] to speak to her. Upon talking, the Commander accepted a position offered by Val to perform requisitions in order to increase the tradehouse's supply.<ref name="Auction">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=general|Help Wanted|Mek-Sha}}</ref>
